e.uuid, e.external_id, e.organization_uuid, e.workspace_uuid, e.name, e.description, e.dataset_uuid, e.dataset_external_id, e.version_uuid, e.version_external_id, e.agent_external_id, e.agent_version, e.environment_external_id, e.timeout_seconds, CAST(e.env AS text) AS env_json, CAST(e.resources AS text) AS resources_json, e.evaluator_set_key, e.status, e.created_by_user_uuid, e.created_at, e.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_experiment_items AS item_row WHERE item_row.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND item_row.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND item_row.experiment_uuid = e.uuid ) AS item_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_experiment_items AS session_row WHERE session_row.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND session_row.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND session_row.experiment_uuid = e.uuid AND session_row.session_external_id IS NOT NULL ) AS session_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_experiment_evaluators AS evaluator_row WHERE evaluator_row.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND evaluator_row.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND evaluator_row.experiment_uuid = e.uuid ) AS evaluator_count
